statuses.name: Burnout
statuses.text: Stacking. Each second the firm causes itself a Scandal per stack; the employee's output falls 5% per stack. Never expires in a fight.

statuses.name: Overtime
statuses.text: Haste. +50% cooldown speed per stack for 3s. When a stack expires the employee gains 1 Burnout.

statuses.name: Bureaucracy
statuses.text: Slow. -20% cooldown speed per stack; each stack lasts 5s independently.

statuses.name: Frozen
statuses.text: Cooldown does not advance. Duration set by the applying ability; re-application extends.
